items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: that Golden Rule, Rondine, they were Gilles Duvarny

ctx.x: I can't ever keep that band straight.

That Golden Rule, let's see how the Golden Rule, that Golden Rule, Rondine, they were Gilles Duvarny, and, uh, and, uh, those men would swap up, like, you understand, one man quit here to take another man in his place, you know? Like, Gilles, that was a guitar, and T-Bar was a guitar, we, oh, we had some of them that I really hadn't forgot all about, guitars, basses, and... Well, who managed it at Golden Rule? Well, the Golden Rule was managed one time by Ambrose, and, uh, another time it was managed by Gilles…
What tunes would they play back in those times?
